results.title: Floodwaters swamp homes and farmland after heavy rainfall in Udala
results.description: Heavy rain triggered severe flooding across Udala in Mayurbhanj district, submerging homes and damaging extensive farmland. Continuous rainfall since Monday night created a critical situation in the region. Water Enters Houses And Anganwadi Center Rainwater flooded several homes in Bausapal village along the Udala-Balasore road. Water entered three houses, the local Anganwadi center, and the Subhadra Shakti Gruha. In Balasore's Jaipur village, floodwater completely submerged two houses, forcing residents to be evacuated to safety. Also Read: Schools, anganwadi centres shut in five districts of Odisha following heavy rainfall Farmland Submerged And Risk Rises The persistent rain damages acres of agricultural land across the area. Many houses remain surrounded by floodwater in Udala, Kaptipada, and Gopabandhu Nagar blocks. As heavy rain continues, the situation threatens to worsen further.

results.title: XAUUSD 4040 discount trap — 4165 next?
results.description: XAUUSD 4040 discount trap — 4165 next? That 4,050 flush looks scary, but this is exactly where late shorts can get baited. Gold pulled back from above 4,100, broke the small recovery structure, and now price is testing the discount zone around 4,040 - 4,020. Yeah, short-term pressure is bearish. No argument there. USD is strong. Fed risk is sitting right in front of the market. Daily structure still leans heavy. But chart-wise? Selling straight into discount after the move already stretched lower feels late. The clean read for me is simple. Gold can sweep into 4,040 - 4,020 first, trap sellers, then try to reclaim back toward 4,093. That 4,093 area is the first gate. If buyers take it back, the next draw is the bearish OB around 4,145 - 4,165. That zone is not a place to blindly buy. It is the real reaction area. Premium price. Previous supply. Clean place for sellers to defend if the bigger bearish structure wants to stay alive. Main bias is bullish recovery while 4,020 holds. Trading scenario: Buy idea only if gold holds the 4,040 - 4,020 discount zone and reclaims above 4,060 with clean candles. Entry zone: 4,020 - 4,050 after confirmation Stop loss: below 3,999 TP1: 4,093 TP2: 4,120 TP3: 4,145 - 4,165 No hold inside discount, no buy. Simple. If gold closes hard below 3,999, this recovery idea is cooked. Then sellers can drag price back toward 3,959. For now, I’m watching the discount sweep first, then 4,093 reclaim. You think gold traps shorts here before running into 4,165?
